description: Denise G. Roberts | Maryland State Delegate Denise Roberts was sworn into the Maryland House of Delegates on January 8, 2024. She serves and represents the residents of District 25, which includes Kettering, Largo, Mitchellville, Upper Marlboro, District Heights, Capitol Heights, Suitland, Morningside, Clinton and Temple Hills.
